name: stage:triage
description: New work item awaiting assessment, dedupe, and clarification.

name: stage:refining
description: Worth exploring; outcome, acceptance criteria, or design still being shaped.

name: stage:ready
description: Definition of Ready met; eligible for explicit agent:go.

name: stage:in-progress
description: Work item has been claimed and is being executed.

name: stage:in-review
description: Pull request exists and is awaiting human review.

name: agent:go
description: Explicit human instruction for the worker to start a ready item.

name: agent:blocked
description: Agent cannot proceed; human input required before further work.

name: needs-design
description: Product-significant item needs a linked human-reviewed design artefact before ready.

name: playbook-candidate
description: Learning or change may generalise back into the Engineering Playbook.
